text:
jen: Heads up — provisioning in us-west-2 started failing ~20m ago after a quick IAM lockdown. GPU warm pool nodes can't unwrap disk keys (KMS), warmups stuck, and some S3 pulls failing. Anyone flip something?

omar: I pushed a temporary IAM policy to limit cross-account assume for staging at ~10:05. Thought it only affected third-party access. Rolling back now if that's the cause.

infra-bot: ALERT: keystore-api 5xx spike in us-west-2 at 10:12 (rate 12/min). Incident I-2156 created.

sre-oncall: Seeing repeated: `AccessDeniedException: User: arn:aws:sts::123456789012:assumed-role/node/bootstrap is not authorized to perform: kms:Decrypt on resource arn:aws:kms:us-west-2:123456789012:key/abcd-ef01` when booting nodes.

paul: Also noticed a NACL change pushed around 10:07 that tightened ephemeral port range. Could be blocking the control-plane -> node agent handshake. @jen can you grep /var/log/agent on one of failed nodes?

jen: grabbing logs from one failed warm node (excerpt):
```
2026-03-18T10:11:35Z boot: request keystore unwrap failed: AccessDeniedException
2026-03-18T10:11:36Z agent: connect to control-plane 10.0.12.7:443 -> connection reset
2026-03-18T10:11:39Z boot: fallback to offline config, marking node degraded
```

security-eng: that IAM change was my PR (#742). It scoped down `sts:AssumeRole` for a couple of infra roles to block cross-account callers. I missed the `node/bootstrap` role in the allowlist. Reverting now. Sorry.

omar: rollback started: `terraform apply -target=aws_iam_policy_attachment.node-keystore` in progress.

jen: some nodes recover after key unwrap; still ~15% fail with same error. Paul — can you confirm the NACL was rolled back or adjusted?

paul: I added an emergency NACL exception to allow TCP ports 1025-65535 from control-plane subnets at 10:22 as a mitigation. Will tighten after nodes are healthy.

infra-bot: Deploy-bot: Terraform apply finished (2m). Changes: reverted IAM policy (PR revert), added NACL exception. Trace: D-apply-2156.

sre-oncall: After revert + NACL change, warm pool success rate jumped to ~92% over last 5m. Still seeing rare `AccessDenied` on a leftover bootstrap role ARN (different account) — digging.

jen: quick cost/observability note — we enabled debug keystore logging during recovery which is writing full audit blobs to s3-audit. If that stays on, it could add ~$300/day in S3 PUTs/ingress for the account. I'll toggle debug off once stable.

security-eng: follow-up plan: 1) add terraform unit tests to prevent accidental scoping of node/bootstrap role; 2) include `affected-roles` in change PR template; 3) run a preflight script that checks node role allowlist before merge. Will open PR today.

omar: opened PR #749 to add a `preflight` check to the CI pipeline for `assume-role` diffs.

jen: owners & action items: - jen: write a short runbook `infra/runbooks/keystore-kms-lockdown.md` with mitigation steps and when to escalate. - omar: follow through on PR #749 and close rollback. - paul: monitor NACL and remove broad exception after warm pool is healthy. - sre-oncall: keep watching I-2156 and mark resolved when success rate >99% for 30m.

paul: noted. I'll also rollback the debug log level after 10:45.

infra-bot: Incident I-2156 update: mitigations applied at 10:22, success rate improving, no customer-facing impact reported.

jen: thanks all. Leaving incident handoff to @sre-oncall. Will follow up with the runbook + postmortem in #postmortems once we confirm root cause and PRs merged.
